title: the Panic type may be named in a contract without importing it, and the untrusted module edge is then the whole answer
notes: The subject is the bare type name `Panic`, not the module edge. The function explicitly declares the foreign failure channel and propagates its Result, so the untrusted module edge remains the only refusal. The original fixture recorded a documentation gap because only the reference exposed the ambient type. During the user-directed Go-only compiler migration (2026-09-07), native public source analysis preserved that existing authoring spelling. specification/failures.mdx §Foreign Exceptions now documents its alpha-0 availability: the type is ambient, while the constructor and panic function still require imports. The unchanged 554-case measurement observed identical VIBE1510@1:23 on both backends and one Go XPASS here; the marker was retired without changing source or expected diagnostics. Native return-channel tests additionally execute the nominal imported constructor with the ambient type, and a separate control rejects using the type as an unimported constructor value. Historical evidence for the earlier discrepancy: <scratchpad>/conv/probes/fc03-untrusted-call-propagated/main.vibe.
